source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U09: Distinguish rulemaking, historical consequential amendments and limitation outcomes

facts.statement: Section38 Gazette rulemaking and parliamentary laying/modification;41 schedule amendments;book expressly labels SICA references historical after repeal. Limitation depends claim/cause and applicable law, not universal3year/12year shortcut.

payload.title: Keep delegated rules and historical cross-references in their own time
payload.core_explanation_md:
Rules are made through the statutory rulemaking power and notification mechanism, with the stated parliamentary laying and modification framework. An internal bank circular does not become a statutory rule merely by reproducing a section number. Equally, subsequent parliamentary modification must be applied with its statutory saving for earlier acts.

The Schedule contains consequential amendments to other enactments. The book expressly identifies the SICA/BIFR discussion as historical after repeal; it should not become a present filing guide. A limitation decision also needs the actual cause of action, remedy, applicable article and any legally effective extension or exclusion. A bare elapsed-year figure is insufficient to determine every secured claim.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a historical BIFR cross-reference be used as a current application instruction?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Establish the applicable legislation and operative procedure.

payload.stem_md: A learning note presents a repealed SICA/BIFR procedure as a current compulsory recovery step. Which edit is required?

options.text_md: Label its historical purpose and separate the current applicable framework
options.explanation_md: The source itself identifies the repeal and historical context.

options.text_md: Change the institution name without checking the legal route
options.explanation_md: Cosmetic relabelling does not establish current law.

options.text_md: Delete every reference to legal history from provenance
options.explanation_md: Historical evidence can remain if its role is accurately described.

options.text_md: Assume an old schedule amendment revives the repealed Act
options.explanation_md: A historical cross-reference does not establish revival.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source itself identifies the repeal and historical context.

payload.stem_md: Only the statement four years have elapsed is supplied for a proposed limitation decision. What is the defensible answer?

options.text_md: Every such claim is necessarily timely
options.explanation_md: The claim and applicable article are unspecified.

options.text_md: Every such claim is necessarily time-barred
options.explanation_md: Some remedies or legally effective events can differ.

options.text_md: Identify the remedy, cause of action and applicable limitation facts before deciding
options.explanation_md: An elapsed period alone is not a complete limitation analysis.

options.text_md: Ignore limitation because this is statutory enforcement

payload.correct_explanation_md: An elapsed period alone is not a complete limitation analysis.
